tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Palette. Deepest ground: photo vignettes, footer, text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Palette. Brand navy: first chart series, revolving-facility bar.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Palette. Quiet button fill on dark sections.

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Palette. Body and label text on Day surfaces (6.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: steel-400
tokens.usage: Palette. Second chart series on Day, third on Night. Not for small text on either surface (4.0:1 Night, 3.8:1 Day).

tokens.name: mist-300
tokens.usage: Palette. Muted text on Night (7.5:1); second chart series on Night, third on Day.

tokens.name: mist-100
tokens.usage: Palette. Body text on Night (12.7:1); hairlines on Day.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section ground. Sections alternate Night and Day down the page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Stat panels laid over photography; inactive segment of a toggle.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, stat numerals and body text on surface (17.6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, captions, labels and units (7.5:1 Night, 6.3:1 Day).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline grid: column rules, cell borders and row dividers. Decorative structure, never a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: outlined buttons and the segmented toggle frame (3:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button and active segment fill. One per view.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action (17.6:1).

tokens.name: action-quiet
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill.

tokens.name: on-action-quiet
tokens.usage: Text on action-quiet (9.4:1 Night, 14.5:1 Day).

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the subject or the new structure. Also the cover's main block.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, the comparison. Label it directly.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Below 3:1 against surface on Day: separate segments with a 1px surface gap and label values on the bar.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring with a 2px surface gap (7.5:1 Night, 10.8:1 Day).
